judul: Automated Muskmelon Counting in Real Farm Environment using YOLOv11n
sumber: Proceeding of the IEEE International Conference on Smart Instrumentation Measurement and Applications Icsima
abstrak: Fruit detection and counting in real farm environments remain challenging due to occlusion, variable lighting, and cluttered backgrounds. This study presents a robust computer vision pipeline for accurately detecting, tracking, and counting melons using the You Only Look Once version 11 nano object detection model. To evaluate and enhance performance, multiple dataset versions with different types of annotation (large annotation, front-row strict annotation, and front-row/rear-row annotation distinction) were utilized alongside various image processing pipelines (Roboflow workflows, detection, tracking, and line-counting tracking). Among these, the 4th method, with a line-counting strategy, significantly improved counting accuracy. Our best result was achieved with the front row strict annotation and line counting tracking combination which yielded a counting error rate of just 2.74%. The system was tested on footage captured by an automated guide vehicle in a greenhouse, demonstrating its practical applicability in real-world, non-laboratory agricultural environments. Overall, this work contributes an efficient and accurate melon counting pipeline, laying the foundation for future work such as fruit maturity prediction and disease detection.
